allow: Bash(powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command 'Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match "chatbot" -and \($_.CommandLine -match "tsx.*watch.*src/main.ts" -or $_.CommandLine -match "src/main.ts"\) } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force; Write-Output \("stopped " + $_.ProcessId\) }')
